document.title: Bangladesh National Building Code (BNBC) 2020
document.structure_secondary: Volume 1: Parts 1-5 (Part 3 general building requirements, Part 4 fire protection); Volume 2: Part 6 structural design; Volume 3: Parts 7-10 (Part 9 alteration and addition); published by the Ministry of Housing and Public Works, gazetted 2021 (from a university slide deck and library catalogues, NOT the code)
document.source_file: BNBC-2020-Gazetted-Enhanced-unlocked.pdf (gazetted 2021-02-11, 2,499 pp; text layer read with pdftotext; page = PDF page index)
